approved_by: user 2026-10-05 ('Approve all three ... make it symmetric and fair'), with the clarifications applied below
freeze_rule: Nothing in this file changes after freezing; changes go in an amendment. Every replicate is reported; none may be dropped, retrained, ranked or selected.
paper_question: Does the same PPO recipe repeatedly produce the A/B distinction? (independent of BEHAVIOR_SIGNATURES_2V2_V1 and Z_INTERVENTION_2V2_V1; results are not combined)
classification: Independent training-seed replication of the 2v2 Ours teachers. Same recipe, new training seeds only.
symmetry: A and B of every replicate use the identical recipe, step budget, foundations-of-their-own-side and evaluation block; the four pairs are read on identical seeds.

recipe_frozen.source: 2v2/run_dual_branch_2v2.py train_args (the recipe that produced the sealed 2v2 teachers); identical argv except --seed, --experiment-id and --run-label-suffix
recipe_frozen.after_training: export each ATTACK branch exactly as the 2v2 driver does (export_attack_branch), then a technical seal per replicate

replicates.compute: 6 runs of 200k steps; about 50 min per run; 3 at a time

evaluation_frozen.pairs: rep1, rep2, rep3 AND the original sealed pair (dual_branch_v1), all read on identical seeds
evaluation_frozen.seed_class: sealed_confirmatory, shared by exactly the four pair labels
evaluation_frozen.episode_path: experiments/eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py with the dual-branch composite flags used for the 2v2 matched-128 (--role-fixed-for-episode --role-k-defend 1 --frozen-attack-path(-b) + shas, --dual-branch-deploy-manifest per pair)

analysis_frozen.statistical_unit: the seed (paired across the four cells of a pair)
analysis_frozen.per_pair: Delta_A = V(A,A) - V(B,A), Delta_B = V(B,B) - V(A,B), win, paired bootstrap 95% (n = 20000, rng 7)
analysis_frozen.headline: k/3 = number of NEW replicates with BOTH mean Delta_A > 0 and mean Delta_B > 0
analysis_frozen.secondary_descriptive: number of NEW replicates with BOTH 95% lower bounds > 0, reported as a count only; it is NOT a gate and does not change the headline
analysis_frozen.also_reported: every pair's Delta_A, Delta_B with 95% intervals (original included), and the mean and range across the three new replicates
analysis_frozen.no_selection: replicates are never ranked, filtered or swapped; a replicate that fails to train is reported as such

launch: after the 4v4 Stage-4 chain finishes (user ordering)
